positions.source: L6b/L7 tools/trees/place.py. Estimated visual layout, not surveyed: 480 near trees from seed 610602 at 270-570 m, plus 1,200 far trees from seed 610607 in twelve 100-tree clusters at 600-1,500 m; 0.25 m grid; preserves the 30+/-8 and 210+/-10 degree crown-cleared gaps and the runway/mown east-west flight corridor. Flat visual vegetation; no collision, terrain or aerodynamics.
